name: @neuropause/operator-deployment
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Version 1.1 Program 1C: Operator Deployment Package. An additive package that composes Waves 1-14, Sprints 1-6, Launch Workstreams 1-5, and Version 1.1 Programs 1A-1B and the 1C environment-provisioning orchestration, unchanged, into an operator-facing first-production-deployment workflow: a deployment wizard (collects cloud provider/region/domain/Kubernetes/PostgreSQL/Redis/object storage/container registry/secrets manager); an environment validator that STOPS at 'PENDING - OPERATOR ACTION REQUIRED' when credentials/Kubernetes/DNS/TLS/registry/storage are not verified; a deployment executor that reuses Program 1B and runs only after operator approval AND successful validation (terraform apply / helm upgrade / kubectl apply — never fabricating success); live validation; automatic rollback on rollout timeout/failed pods/unhealthy API/failed migrations; an evidence package (terraform output, rollout logs, pod status, certificates, database health, monitoring, backups — never auto-promoted); an operator dashboard (Pending/Running/Succeeded/Failed/Verified — no simulated values); and documentation. The wizard, validator, executor, live validation, rollback engine, evidence package, dashboard, documentation, and governance are LIVE-VERIFIED in-process; cloud credentials, the Kubernetes API, the container registry, the DNS provider, and the TLS issuer are ADAPTER-VERIFIED; deployment runs, rollout metrics, and live-validation results are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING; and a reachable cluster/databases/registry/DNS and a production rollout are INFRASTRUCTURE-PENDING. It creates no infrastructure and claims no deployment; nothing moves to Verified without real evidence. Every activity is recorded on the one governance chain with a replay id.
